entities.summary: Marc Miller is a Canadian lawyer and politician who has been Minister of Canadian Identity and Culture, and the Minister responsible for Official Languages since 2025. A member of the Liberal Party, Miller was elected as the member of Parliament (MP) for Ville-Marie—Le Sud-Ouest—Île-des-Sœurs in the 2015 federal election. Miller was previously Minister of Indigenous Services from 2019 to 2021, Minister of Crown–Indigenous Relations from 2021 to 2023, and Minister of Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship from 2023 to 2025.
